newsitem.title: USA: SouthFirst to merge with First Chilton.
newsitem.headline: SouthFirst to merge with First Chilton.

text.p: SouthFirst Bancshares Inc in conjunction with First Federal Savings and Loan Association of Chilton County said on Tuesday that they have signed a definitive agreement to merge and create a company with combined assets in excess of $160 million.
Under the terms, Chilton County will be merged with First Federal of the South, a wholly-owned subsidiary of SouthFirst Bancshares.
First Federal of the South will be the surviving bank in the merger.
The merger is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1997 and will be accounted for as a purchase transaction, it said.
The transaction is expected to have an aggregate value of $5.3 million, or $30 per Chilton County common share,
SouthFirst President and Chief Executive Don Stroup, said "We envision expanded growth and profitability for the Bank in Chilton County."
Chilton County president and chief executive Bobby Cook, said that "joining SouthFirst will increase our ability to meet the banking needs of Chilton County."
